title: FleetFile
description: A national ship-data file: the classes, aircraft and hulls of one navy at one snapshot date (data/ships/<nation>.json). The date lives in as_of and nowhere else, so the same schema serves a 1922, 1930, 1936 or 1941 snapshot.

as_of.description: Snapshot date every status in this file describes.

source.description: Prose document that owns these facts, where one exists.

aircraft.description: Aircraft types this navy operates. Inventory, not ship armament.

notes.description: What the file as a whole has to say that no class or hull owns — most usefully, WHAT THIS NAVY IS NOT PERMITTED TO HAVE. A prohibition is data: Germany's 1922 file is defined as much by the categories Versailles forbids her as by the eight obsolete battleships it allows, and without this field there is nowhere to say so.
